hook: Kukatpally truck park's *3.15 acres* up for auction, protests grow
hook_b: Kukatpally truck park's *3.15 acres* up for auction, protests grow
tldr: BRS leaders led by T Harish Rao visited the Kukatpally truck park site on Friday and backed residents protesting the proposed auction of 3.15 acres earmarked for the truck park.

beats.what: CPI and CPM have also joined the protest and want the government to withdraw the proposal, per Telangana Today.
beats.why: Residents say land earmarked for public purposes is being put up for sale.
beats.care: Kukatpally residents and truck operators who use the park are directly affected by what happens to the site.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Harish Rao inspected the site with MLAs Madhavaram Krishna Rao and KP Vivekananda and said BRS would oppose the auction.

cards.q: What should happen to public land like the Kukatpally truck park?

qs: What did the 2013 plan propose, and why was it dropped?
What would the site be used for if not auctioned?

facts.t: A sale attempt in *2013* was foiled after all political parties opposed it, protesters say.

steps.e: Sale attempt dropped after all parties opposed

viz.verdict: Opposition parties back residents; government has not responded in the report

cover.label: truck park land proposed for auction

watch: Whether the government goes ahead with the auction or withdraws the proposal.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: BRS backs protest against proposed auction of 3.15 acres at Kukatpally truck park

fact: Protest grows against auction of *3.15 acres* at Kukatpally truck park.
twist: The same land was put up for sale in *2013*; protesters say all parties blocked it then.
